historical_claims.anchor: Davis and Kahan state this as their inequality 5.1, and the same argument extends to unbounded self-adjoint coefficients
This is Davis and Kahan's inequality 5.2.
Davis and Kahan remark that 5.2 is not best possible unless the rank is one, and ask whether the factor root r can be replaced by a universal constant.

Later work answered yes: for self-adjoint coefficients whose spectra are distance delta apart, the operator norm of X is at most pi over two times the operator norm of Y divided by delta, and pi over two cannot be improved.
